changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: The invested series charts the money invested at each month, not the money ever put in (issue #419). Every purchase still adds one row in the month it happened in: stock lots, crypto lots and fund contributions, unchanged. A fourth branch adds one row per finances.results exit, withdrawals and reinvestments alike, subtracting its cost_basis in the month of its result_date, so a fully exited holding nets to zero from its exit month on while its earlier months keep the money it held then. A reinvestment's destination lot or contribution already adds the reinvested amount in its own branch, so reinvested money is counted once, in the destination, from the reinvestment date. The columns and their order are unchanged, which is what lets CREATE OR REPLACE work.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW finances.contributions_timeline AS SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, 'STOCKS'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, date_trunc('month', stock_lots.lot_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, stock_lots.quantity * stock_lots.price AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, stock_lots.quantity * stock_lots.price * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.stock_lots JOIN finances.stock_holdings ON stock_holdings.id = stock_lots.stock_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = stock_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, 'CRYPTO'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, date_trunc('month', crypto_lots.lot_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, crypto_lots.quantity * crypto_lots.price AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, crypto_lots.quantity * crypto_lots.price * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.crypto_lots JOIN finances.crypto_holdings ON crypto_holdings.id = crypto_lots.crypto_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = crypto_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, 'FUNDS'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, date_trunc('month', fund_contributions.contribution_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, fund_contributions.amount AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, fund_contributions.amount * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.fund_contributions JOIN finances.fund_holdings ON fund_holdings.id = fund_contributions.fund_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = fund_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, CASE WHEN results.stock_holding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'STOCKS'::finances.wallet_kind WHEN results.crypto_holding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CRYPTO'::finances.wallet_kind ELSE 'FUNDS'::finances.wallet_kind END AS kind, date_trunc('month', results.result_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, -results.cost_basis AS wallet_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate, -results.cost_basis * COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS amount FROM finances.results LEFT JOIN finances.stock_holdings ON stock_holdings.id = results.stock_holding_id LEFT JOIN finances.crypto_holdings ON crypto_holdings.id = results.crypto_holding_id LEFT JOIN finances.fund_holdings ON fund_holdings.id = results.fund_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = COALESCE( stock_holdings.wallet_id, crypto_holdings.wallet_id, fund_holdings.wallet_id ) LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency;
